<documents>
<document id="account-verification-time">
HowˆlongˆverificationˆtakesˆMostˆapplicationsˆareˆverifiedˆwithinˆ1ˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆmanyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆManualˆreviewˆIfˆweˆneedˆtoˆcheckˆsomethingˆbyˆhand,ˆitˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆmayˆaskˆforˆanotherˆdocument,ˆsuchˆasˆproofˆofˆaddress.ˆ##ˆWhileˆyouˆwaitˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdepositsˆintoˆyourˆnewˆaccount,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcashˆorˆorderˆaˆcardˆuntilˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆCheckingˆstatusˆTheˆappˆshowsˆyourˆverificationˆstatusˆonˆtheˆhomeˆscreen.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆasˆsoonˆasˆit'sˆdone.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆspeedˆitˆup?ˆNo.ˆVerificationˆisˆhandledˆbyˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆapproveˆapplicationsˆorˆtellˆyouˆmoreˆthanˆtheˆappˆshows.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆanythingˆfromˆyou,ˆwe'llˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆCommonˆcausesˆofˆdelaysˆAˆblurryˆIDˆphoto,ˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆIDˆexactly,ˆorˆaˆrecentˆmoveˆareˆtheˆmostˆcommonˆreasonsˆweˆneedˆaˆmanualˆreview.ˆCheckingˆtheseˆbeforeˆyouˆapplyˆhelps.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-joint-accounts">
Doˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆindividualˆaccountsˆonly.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆandˆyouˆcan'tˆaddˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆaˆsecondˆcardˆholder.ˆ##ˆSharingˆmoneyˆwithˆaˆpartnerˆEachˆofˆyouˆcanˆopenˆyourˆownˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆandˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆeachˆotherˆinstantlyˆwithˆBrookPay,ˆforˆfree.ˆ##ˆSharedˆgoalsˆSavingsˆPocketsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆaccountˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆshared.ˆYouˆcanˆeachˆsaveˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆgoalˆinˆyourˆownˆpockets.ˆ##ˆManagingˆanˆaccountˆforˆsomeoneˆelseˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆseeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney".ˆOtherwise,ˆweˆcanˆonlyˆtalkˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆholder.ˆ##ˆWillˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆWeˆdon'tˆhaveˆplansˆtoˆshareˆrightˆnow.ˆ##ˆCouplesˆandˆroommatesˆSplittingˆaˆbillˆisˆeasyˆwithˆBrookPay.ˆOneˆpersonˆpays,ˆandˆtheˆotherˆsendsˆtheirˆshareˆstraightˆfromˆtheˆapp.ˆBrookPayˆhasˆnoˆfeeˆandˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆfromˆaˆjointˆaccountˆelsewhereˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆaˆjointˆaccountˆyouˆholdˆatˆanotherˆbankˆasˆanˆexternalˆaccount,ˆasˆlongˆasˆyourˆnameˆisˆonˆit.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
